title: Qualcomm's AI Infrastructure Pivot Is Underappreciated
author: Marc Guberti
description: Qualcomm is positioning itself for significant growth in 2027 through its pivot into AI infrastructure, with deals secured from Amazon and Meta Platforms. The company expects non-handset revenue to grow over 60% in fiscal 2027 and projects a $200 billion CPU market opportunity by fiscal 2029, yet trades at a modest 23 P/E ratio that undervalues its growth potential.

title: TXN Surges 67% Over the Past Year: Is the Stock Still Worth Buying?
author: Na
description: Texas Instruments (TXN) has surged 66.6% over the past year, outperforming peers like Broadcom, QUALCOMM, and NVIDIA. Despite premium valuation (P/E of 30.99), the company's strong Q2'26 results (23% revenue growth, 52% EPS growth), doubling data center revenues, and $7.5-9.5B in government manufacturing incentives support further upside potential. Analysts maintain a Buy rating citing expanding AI infrastructure exposure and robust cash generation.

title: Micron Technology vs. Qualcomm: What Revenue Trends Tell Investors About These Tech Companies
author: Robert Izquierdo
description: Micron Technology's revenue surged 432% over two years, reaching $41.5 billion in Q2 2026, driven by AI boom demand for memory chips. Meanwhile, Qualcomm's revenue declined in 2026 due to rising component prices compressing margins and reducing smartphone demand. Qualcomm is pivoting toward AI data centers to offset mobile business headwinds.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Exceptional revenue acceleration with 432% growth over two years, explosive Q1-Q2 2026 performance ($23.9B and $41.5B), strategic partnerships with major automakers, and critical positioning in the AI boom.

Revenue declined in 2026 after consistent growth, facing margin compression from rising memory component prices, reduced smartphone demand, and loss of market share to competitors benefiting from AI trends. Company is forced to pivot business strategy toward AI data centers.
Mentioned as a new Qualcomm customer for AI data center services, indicating Qualcomm's strategic shift, but no direct impact on Amazon's business performance discussed.
